comment: Seed for scripts/workstream-lock.mjs — the task DAG from docs/confit-implementation-plan.md §4. `phase` is P0 for the all-hands Phase-0 tasks, otherwise the owning lane (A–F, §3.6). depends_on mirrors the task table's 'Depends on' column; prose-only dependencies are recorded as notes.

T0.1.title: Repo bootstrap: Vite + React 18 + TS strict + Tailwind + zustand + vitest + Playwright; gate script stubs; deploy target wired

T0.2.title: Contracts freeze: §3 files + working stubs + fixtures

T0.3.title: x-vec spike: encrypted vector write + similarity round-trip; pass/fail verdict by 0:20

T0.4.title: Pot-relay deployed with DEMO_TOKEN; curl round-trip from two machines

A1.title: KeyService: PBKDF2-SHA256 → AES-256-GCM key; two hardcoded accounts

A2.title: Vault: IndexedDB encrypted records; put/get for narrative/usual/meallog

A3.title: x-vec vault adapter + local fallback behind flags.vaultBackend

A4.title: Boundary interceptor (no vault-plaintext to pot/x-vec origins) + boundary.spec.ts

A5.title: Destroy-my-key control: wipes key + vault; reveal shows unreadable store
A5.note: stretch task (§4) — first to skip if the lane is behind

B2.title: Remote pot: x-vec collection primary, relay fallback, flags.potBackend
B2.note: table lists T0.3/4 — either backend suffices in practice; The Pass flips flags.potBackend live (§2.2)

B3.title: census() + matched() with KFLOOR=5; never expose sub-floor cohorts

B4.title: stats() for reveal, seed(), reset() glue to The Pass

C1.title: Extractor: Haiku json_schema structured output, off-limits pre+post filters, retry → seeded fallback

C2.title: Narrator: Sonnet structured card copy, facts-only prompt, linter check → regenerate → template

C3.title: Embedder: MiniLM quantized in a worker, preload at unlock, null on failure
C3.note: off the demo spine (§2.1a) — cut before any spine work

C4.title: Runtime copy-linter hook: banned-lexicon scan on every model string before render

D1.title: Usual + meal log fixture shapes; provisioning payloads for accounts A/B

D3.title: AskEngine: §3.4 scoring, pure + deterministic under demoMode

D4.title: Nudge rules: opt-in default off, once/day guard, permanent silence, DemoBus arm

E1.title: Shell: unlock screen, routes /confess /ask /reveal /settings /pass, design tokens

E2.title: Confess: textarea → editable chips → Add to the pot → vault+pot writes; blocked-topic state
E2.note: stub-first (§5.2): build against the stub extractor/vault; integrator wires live C1 at ~1:50

E3.title: Ask + Card: pick, reason, cohort citation, rotation/usual lines, cohort-miss, runners-up, I-went button
E3.note: stub-first (§5.2): build against stub engine/narrator/cohorts; wired at Gate 2

E4.title: Reveal: N lessons pooled · 0 readable + raw vault blob viewer

E6.title: Nudge surface: quiet banner, dismiss, silence-forever

F1.title: Corpus: 40 hand-picked local places per §3.1 schema, tuned for the demo city

F2.title: Seeds: 220 lessons, every demo driver k∈[5,9], near-tie tuned for B; gen-seeds script

F3.title: The Pass admin panel (§10): seed/reset, census, near-tie inspector, provisioning, toggles

F4.title: CI wiring: §9 tests, npm run gate1 / gate2 real

F5.title: Demo prep: devices provisioned, wifi tested, script printed, 3 rehearsals
F5.note: plan says depends on 'all' (§4) — F3+F4 recorded per the DAG; in truth gated by the 4:00 freeze, stretch tasks (A5, C3) excluded
